description: This file defines a plugin class for a Treemap chart using ECharts within the Apache Superset project. It imports necessary modules, images, and types, and sets up metadata, behaviors, and chart loading logic.

classes.name: EchartsTreemapChartPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for rendering ECharts Treemap visualizations, extending the EchartsChartPlugin base class, with configuration for behaviors, metadata, and chart loading.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with metadata, behaviors, chart loading function, and other configuration options.
